recommended_path: Udruga (association) under the Act on Associations (NN 74/14, 70/17, 98/19), registered with the county administrative office (or City of Zagreb) by seat
entity_types: Udruga (association) — the standard nonprofit form under the Act on Associations
Javno korisna (public-benefit) association — separate Ministry of Interior status layered on top, not needed for tech grants

requirements.founders: At least 3 founders. Any natural person not deprived of legal capacity; legal persons (incl. foreign legal persons) and foreign nationals can be founders. Minors aged 14+ or incapacitated persons may found only with a notarised letter of consent from their legal representative/guardian; at least one founder must be an adult with full capacity, and only such persons may be the authorised representative
requirements.local_presence: Registered with the competent county administrative office (or City of Zagreb for Zagreb seat) according to the association's seat; no separate residence or local-agent requirement stated by gov.hr
requirements.documents: Standard application form (Obrazac broj 1) in two identical copies; minutes of the founding assembly; statute; list of founders; names of authorised representatives and liquidator; certified statements on absence of obstacles per Art. 11(7)-(8) and Art. 19(2)-(3) of the Act; extract from the companies register for a foreign legal-person founder; ID/passport copies of founders, liquidator and representatives; sectoral approval where a special law requires it

forms: Obrazac broj 1 — Application Form for Registration in the Register of Associations (mpu.gov.hr); e-filing available via mpu.gov.hr

fees.amount: unverified — gov.hr states no fee for registration; no official fee amount confirmed this round
fees.note: Certification of statements and ID copies may cost extra (certified/notarised copies); third-party guides cite ~500-1,500 HRK in combined costs but no official figure was confirmed — treat as unverified

timelines.registration: unverified — no statutory timeline stated on gov.hr; appeals go to the Ministry of Justice, Public Administration and Digital Transformation

supersedes: Prior enrich-task claim 'medium difficulty, ~500-1,500 HRK fees + notary' — fee figure NOT verified against any official source; only the document list and process are verified. Downgraded to unverified fee.
notes: Citizens of 0.25% PIT (payroll income tax) earmark donations — a separate donor-side mechanism

All newly founded associations must use double-entry bookkeeping and file financial reports to the Ministry of Finance for at least the first 3 years (third-party guide, expatincroatia.com, updated 2026-08)
GfNP: Croatia on the official Google for Nonprofits country list (support.google.com), confirmed in _gfnp_audit.json
MSfN: Croatia confirmed in TechSoup's Microsoft-for-Nonprofits available-countries list (techsoup.org/microsoft country list rendered in page)
